title: [feat]/ Save and share DJ effect presets and unit layouts
problem: Effects are ephemeral; performers cannot recall a named deck performance chain for a routine. Serato advanced presets are an expansion benchmark.
acceptance: Save names, order, routing and parameters of performance FX units
Recall atomically with an explicit tail/reset policy
Import/export a versioned preset without depending on proprietary Serato formats
validation: Round-trip presets and switch them during playback while checking routing and tails.

title: [feat]/ Add instant doubles and deck transfer
problem: Loading the same file again resets deck state; scratch routines need a copy of the active transport position and settings.
acceptance: Copy a source deck to a target with coherent playhead, pitch, loop and key state
Provide a separate move operation that preserves audible continuity
Respect target-deck load protection and show source/target clearly
validation: Compare output phase before and after doubles/transfers while looping and key locked.

title: [feat]/ Add momentary loop-roll pad performance
problem: Auto/manual deck loops exist, but held beat-division rolls do not return to an advancing timeline.
acceptance: Trigger selectable beat-division rolls while a pad is held
Restore the underlying playhead on release
Offer per-deck quantization and coherent overlapping-pad priority
validation: Capture impulse-grid audio through held/retriggered rolls and confirm release position.

title: [feat]/ Add reverse playback and momentary censor controls
problem: Deck commands have no persistent reverse or momentary reverse-with-return operation.
acceptance: Support reverse transport with defined boundary/loop behavior
Provide hold-to-censor that resumes the forward timeline on release
Make direction explicit in waveform, UI and controller feedback
validation: Test direction switches and censor-release timing without clicks on several audio formats.

title: [feat]/ Add beat-synced sampler playback and output assignments
problem: DJ sample loops need tempo matching and channel selection independent of the synthesizer-oriented sampler paths.
acceptance: Sync beat-tagged sample loops to the chosen performance clock
Assign sampler output to master, cue or a chosen deck/bus
Provide per-slot level/mute plus a dedicated sampler master
validation: Record loop phase through tempo changes and validate separate physical output routing.

title: [feat]/ Add scratch banks with instant return to the previous deck track
problem: Builtin stem loading does not provide user-configured scratch sample banks or restoration of the previous track state.
acceptance: Assign library tracks and cue start points to scratch-bank slots
Preload entries and recall start, loop and key-lock preferences
Return to the previous deck state deliberately after a scratch-bank routine
validation: Switch banks repeatedly while another deck plays and verify previous track restoration.

title: [feat]/ Add moving and fixed-loop slicer pad modes
problem: There is no grid-sliced deck performance mode for rearranging phrases live. Serato availability depends on hardware.
acceptance: Divide a selected beat domain into pad-addressable slices
Offer moving-domain and repeating-domain behavior
Provide quantized slice triggering and clear visual domain boundaries
validation: Run a numbered transient fixture through changing domain/quantize settings and hardware triggers.

title: [feat]/ Link set recordings to performed-track and cue markers
problem: A recording file alone is hard to review or deliver; no relationship exists between audio capture and performance history. This is an Omatainer workflow proposal informed by separate Serato recording/history features.
acceptance: Associate recording sample offsets with track/deck history entries
Export an editable cue sheet or chapter/marker sidecar without modifying the audio master
Handle pauses/split recording files without losing time alignment
validation: Record known transitions with pauses and file splitting, then compare exported markers to decoded audio.

title: [feat]/ Convert recorded melodies, harmony and drums to editable MIDI
problem: No analysis path converts audio into note events; users must transcribe samples manually.
acceptance: Provide separate monophonic melody, polyphonic harmony and percussive onset conversion workflows.
Preview detected events with confidence/quantization options and correct them before commit.
Create an editable MIDI clip aligned to its source without deleting the audio.
Use independently implemented or properly licensed models and document supported input limitations.
validation: Transcribe authorized melody, chord and drum fixtures, measure pitch/onset precision and complete correction in the piano roll.

title: [feat]/ Add probabilistic clip and scene follow actions
problem: The sequencer has no autonomous clip/scene transitions, limiting evolving arrangements and hands-free shows.
acceptance: Configure timed next, previous, first, last, random, stop and repeat actions for clips and scenes.
Support weighted alternatives and action timing independent of clip length.
Show the current action group and next scheduled decision without conflating it with manual launching.
Persist random seeds for reproducible offline renders while allowing a fresh performance seed.
validation: Run a seeded 100-transition set with mixed clip lengths, verify scheduled outcomes and then interrupt it manually without orphaned notes.

title: [feat]/ Support lawful legacy and platform-specific plug-in interoperability
problem: Existing projects may depend on VST2 or macOS Audio Units; these are not universally loadable on Linux.
evidence: Audited baseline: https://github.com/michaelmonetized/omatainer/blob/cae546c7bc840ec1a643e4befe18f91e86d0e4c7/src/engine/mod.rs#L365 and https://github.com/michaelmonetized/omatainer/blob/cae546c7bc840ec1a643e4befe18f91e86d0e4c7/Cargo.toml. This capability is absent or materially narrower in the current command model, UI and dependency graph.

Benchmark/reference: https://help.ableton.com/hc/en-us/articles/5937501570460-Supported-Plug-in-Formats. Requirements below are proposed Omatainer behavior, not a claim of identical vendor implementation.
acceptance: Define native versus optional bridge support for legacy/platform formats based on actual SDK and distribution rights.
Keep AU support conditional on a macOS port and never claim native Linux AU compatibility.
Provide explicit architecture/format mismatch diagnostics and rendered-stem fallback migration.
Validate supported paths with licensed plugins; document unavailable formats rather than spoofing compatibility.
validation: Exercise the workflow through the shipped UI, persist/reopen applicable state, and test cancellation and failure paths. Record the actual supported platform and fixture results.

title: [feat]/ Support multichannel and immersive production as an advanced workflow
problem: Film, installation and immersive specialists need channel layouts beyond stereo; this is an extension beyond Live/Serato core parity.
evidence: Audited baseline: https://github.com/michaelmonetized/omatainer/blob/cae546c7bc840ec1a643e4befe18f91e86d0e4c7/src/engine/mod.rs#L365 and https://github.com/michaelmonetized/omatainer/blob/cae546c7bc840ec1a643e4befe18f91e86d0e4c7/Cargo.toml. This capability is absent or materially narrower in the current command model, UI and dependency graph.
Professional-readiness requirement inferred from the combined producer/live-DJ brief; not asserted to be a bundled feature of either reference product.
acceptance: Add explicit speaker-layout buses and panners with channel-order contracts.
Support downmix audition and export metadata for declared layouts.
Treat branded immersive/object formats as optional integrations requiring actual SDK/licensing availability.
Validate routing, downmix coefficients and export round trips with calibrated multichannel fixtures.
validation: Exercise the workflow through the shipped UI, persist/reopen applicable state, and test cancellation and failure paths. Record the actual supported platform and fixture results.

title: [feat]/ Expose performance timing and mixer state for lighting systems
problem: There is no lighting interface. SoundSwitch integration is a separate third-party ecosystem; its private API and Linux availability are not assumed.
acceptance: Offer a documented transport/beat/deck/fader-state interface suitable for an authorized lighting adapter
Support a verified open timing path and explicit opt-in connection state
Keep lighting failures off the audio path and document unsupported third-party combinations
validation: Use an actual compatible lighting controller or separate supported host; verify beat, loop and fader response without claiming untested SoundSwitch support.

title: [feat]/ Add chromatic cue-point performance pads
problem: Sampler note transposition does not pitch deck cue points. Serato Pitch Play is tied to the optional Pitch n Time expansion.
acceptance: Choose a cue as the pad root and display semitone assignments
Offer selectable pitch ranges with explicit original-key reset
Keep deck tempo independent and release voices/actions correctly across modes
validation: Verify pitch using tonal fixtures and fast pad routines with cue selection changes.

title: [feat]/ Support post-production session exchange and broadcast media metadata
problem: Scoring and post-production specialists need timecode-aware handoffs beyond music-only files; this exceeds the named core benchmarks.
evidence: Audited baseline: https://github.com/michaelmonetized/omatainer/blob/cae546c7bc840ec1a643e4befe18f91e86d0e4c7/src/engine/mod.rs#L365 and https://github.com/michaelmonetized/omatainer/blob/cae546c7bc840ec1a643e4befe18f91e86d0e4c7/Cargo.toml. This capability is absent or materially narrower in the current command model, UI and dependency graph.
Professional-readiness requirement inferred from the combined producer/live-DJ brief; not asserted to be a bundled feature of either reference product.
acceptance: Provide a documented AAF/OMF/BWF interoperability plan using available licensed/open implementations.
Preserve source offsets, timestamps, handles, fades and channel assignments for supported exchanges.
Export consolidated media and detailed reports for unsupported effects or edit constructs.
Validate representative handoffs with an independent post-production tool and retain the original project.
validation: Exercise the workflow through the shipped UI, persist/reopen applicable state, and test cancellation and failure paths. Record the actual supported platform and fixture results.

title: [feat]/ Provide audio clip fades and editable arrangement crossfades
problem: Audio clips have no fade envelopes or overlap-editing controls, making polished cuts impossible.
acceptance: Add adjustable fade-in/out durations and curves to every audio clip instance.
Create editable crossfades between adjacent or overlapping regions.
Offer automatic short edge fades without modifying original media.
Maintain linked phase-consistent fades across multitrack edits.
validation: Edit sine, drum and vocal clips at non-zero crossings and measure transition discontinuities before and after fades.

title: [feat]/ Offer distinct high-quality warp modes for drums, tones, textures and mixes
problem: The current fixed overlap-add keylock is a deck effect, not selectable production-grade clip warping.
acceptance: Provide transient-preserving, tonal, texture, resampling and full-mix stretch modes with honest descriptions.
Allow independent pitch, time and applicable formant controls with automation.
Use offline-quality rendering options and report algorithmic latency to the host.
Select original or properly licensed algorithms and document quality/CPU tradeoffs without claiming proprietary algorithm compatibility.
validation: Run listening and objective transient/pitch tests on licensed drum, vocal and full-mix fixtures across slow/fast tempo changes.

title: [feat]/ Isolate plugin failures and restore processing without losing sessions
problem: One third-party effect must not destroy the project or take every deck down.
evidence: Audited baseline: https://github.com/michaelmonetized/omatainer/blob/cae546c7bc840ec1a643e4befe18f91e86d0e4c7/src/engine/mod.rs#L365 and https://github.com/michaelmonetized/omatainer/blob/cae546c7bc840ec1a643e4befe18f91e86d0e4c7/Cargo.toml. This capability is absent or materially narrower in the current command model, UI and dependency graph.
Professional-readiness requirement inferred from the combined producer/live-DJ brief; not asserted to be a bundled feature of either reference product.
acceptance: Offer documented per-plugin or per-group process isolation with bounded audio transport.
On plugin crash preserve state/automation and switch to controlled bypass or silence according to policy.
Restart the failed instance and restore state with user-visible diagnostics.
Measure isolation latency and inject crashes/hangs while unaffected tracks keep their audio deadlines.
validation: Exercise the workflow through the shipped UI, persist/reopen applicable state, and test cancellation and failure paths. Record the actual supported platform and fixture results.

title: [feat]/ Publish hardware profiles backed by end-to-end compatibility evidence
problem: Current family-name matches and a label-selection test do not establish a working controller. Broad Pioneer/Numark/Akai promises need per-model evidence.
acceptance: Version profiles by model, protocol and firmware where necessary
Publish tested transport, mixer, pads, jog, feedback and audio functions separately
Mark unknown Linux driver/protocol support as unverified rather than inheriting Serato compatibility
validation: Run recorded message fixtures plus physical-device end-to-end qualification for every advertised model.

title: [feat]/ Add editable multitrack automation lanes and breakpoint curves
problem: Parameters are only immediate state changes; there is no song-time automation representation or editor.
acceptance: Create named lanes for automatable mixer, device and transport parameters.
Draw, select, curve, copy, scale and numerically edit breakpoints with musical snapping.
Resolve automation by stable parameter identity across device moves and track reorder.
Render automation identically in realtime and offline, including tempo changes and seeks.
validation: Automate a complete mix with curved filter, volume and tempo moves, export it and compare parameter/audio timestamps.

title: [feat]/ Make device chains editable, inspectable and reusable with A/B states
problem: The FX panel can add/toggle slots but cannot remove, reorder, name parameters or manage presets.
acceptance: Add, remove, reorder, copy and bypass devices with stable parameter identities and predictable tails.
Give each device named, unit-aware controls, modulation/automation indication and accessible editing.
Save/load user presets and compare A/B parameter states without overwriting the saved preset.
Support device replacement with explicit mapping-loss warnings and uninterrupted unaffected tracks.
validation: Build, reorder and duplicate a chain while playing, compare A/B presets, reopen the project and verify order/state/automation.

title: [feat]/ Add named arrangement locators, musical scrubbing and loop-region navigation
problem: There are no song-position controls or locators beyond the deck waveform seeks.
acceptance: Create, name, move and trigger arrangement locators while stopped, playing or recording.
Provide quantized previous/next locator jumps and direct time/beat entry.
Offer loop-to-next-locator and editable arrangement loop braces.
Make seeking chase appropriate MIDI state and safely end notes belonging to the old position.
validation: Navigate a live set of named sections by keyboard and mapped controller, including jumps into sustained notes and meter changes.

title: [feat]/ Add count-in, punch recording and multi-pass recording workflows
problem: Record currently toggles a boolean and inserts fixed-length MIDI notes; there is no musician-facing punch/take workflow.
acceptance: Provide explicit record-arm, count-in, pre-roll and punch-in/out controls per relevant recording context.
Capture aligned audio/MIDI to the arrangement with clear input monitoring state.
Retain loop-record passes and show growing waveforms/events during recording.
Handle disk errors, transport stop and device loss without presenting an incomplete take as successful.
validation: Record a guitarist with pre-roll and punch boundaries while MIDI plays, then verify actual recorded timing, take retention and error recovery.

title: [feat]/ Send and receive Link Audio streams with track-level routing and latency controls
problem: Live12.4 stable adds network audio to Link; Omatainer currently has neither peer timing nor network-audio source tracks.
acceptance: Discover authorized Link Audio peers and expose their named track streams as routable inputs/outputs.
Provide buffering/latency and sync-to-incoming-audio controls with clear clock consequences.
Record incoming streams into aligned audio clips and show underruns or disconnected sources.
Verify protocol/SDK licensing and interoperate with current released peers rather than claiming generic network audio is Link Audio.
validation: Send and receive several tracks with a released Live12.4 peer on wired and impaired networks; verify recorded alignment and graceful failure.

title: [feat]/ Extract editable production stems from complete clips or selected time ranges
problem: The decoder has no source-separation workflow. Stable Live Suite 12.3/12.4 provides a benchmark for editable production stems; live DJ stem controls are separate.
acceptance: Run an explicit background separation job producing vocal, drums, bass and remaining accompaniment tracks.
Process only requested audible/time-selected material and retain sample-accurate alignment.
Allow selected stems to be merged into a new clip while preserving originals and job provenance.
Offer cancellation, progress and capability checks; choose a redistributable or separately licensed model with documented terms.
validation: Separate authorized mixed material, re-sum outputs, inspect leakage/alignment and confirm cancellation never replaces the original clips.

title: [feat]/ Add momentary and latched performance-pad FX
problem: The effect window is parameter-oriented and has no reusable deck pad-FX performance layer.
acceptance: Assign effect presets to pads with explicit hold or latch behavior
Allow beat-division and wet/depth parameter controls
Clear pending pad effects safely when changing modes or unloading a track
validation: Stress chorded pads, mode changes and track loads while recording effect state and audio.

title: [feat]/ Add controller layers, modifiers and takeover policies
problem: A shared four-Boolean shift array cannot express independent device banks, multiple modifiers or safe fader pickup across deck layers.
acceptance: Scope modifiers to device and layer with explicit hold/toggle semantics
Allow the same physical control to target different decks or modes
Use pickup/range policies for absolute controls when a layer changes
validation: Test simultaneous devices and held modifiers across disconnects and mode switches.

title: [feat]/ Implement a groove pool with audio/MIDI extraction and commitment
problem: Only fixed quantization exists; there is no reusable swing/timing/velocity groove representation.
acceptance: Import or extract timing and dynamics from user-authorized audio/MIDI material.
Apply adjustable groove timing, quantization, velocity and randomness non-destructively.
Share named groove templates across clips and preview their effect.
Commit a groove to editable events/warp markers with undo and without altering the template.
validation: Extract a drummer groove, apply it to MIDI bass and audio percussion, then commit and compare event/transient timing.

title: [feat]/ Create reviewable collaboration packages with mix notes and references
problem: Collaborators need a common revision, reference mixes and unambiguous requested changes.
evidence: Audited baseline: https://github.com/michaelmonetized/omatainer/blob/cae546c7bc840ec1a643e4befe18f91e86d0e4c7/src/engine/mod.rs#L365 and https://github.com/michaelmonetized/omatainer/blob/cae546c7bc840ec1a643e4befe18f91e86d0e4c7/Cargo.toml. This capability is absent or materially narrower in the current command model, UI and dependency graph.
Professional-readiness requirement inferred from the combined producer/live-DJ brief; not asserted to be a bundled feature of either reference product.
acceptance: Package a versioned session or aligned stems with notes, locators and media manifest.
Attach time-based review notes and resolve them without changing audio unintentionally.
Import collaborator changes into a copy with conflict preview.
Verify offline handoff between clean user accounts and preserve authorship/reference metadata.
validation: Exercise the workflow through the shipped UI, persist/reopen applicable state, and test cancellation and failure paths. Record the actual supported platform and fixture results.

title: [feat]/ Trigger a saved loop from its associated cue marker
problem: Serato 5.0 public beta promotes Cue Loops; this is a preview benchmark beyond ordinary stable saved loops. Omatainer has separate transient cues and one loop.
acceptance: Associate a cue with an explicit loop length/region
Trigger cue and loop atomically with deck quantization
Display the association and allow a cue-only override
validation: Test cue-loop triggers across load/reload and tempo changes; label comparison as beta.

title: [feat]/ Record and replay nondestructive cue and censor routines
problem: There is no reusable deck edit/routine recording. Serato Flip is an optional expansion benchmark, not part of the baseline license assumption.
acceptance: Capture cue, censor and timing actions as an editable per-track routine
Replay with quantization, enable/disable and loop controls
Save multiple named variants without rewriting original audio
validation: Record a routine, reload the track and compare replayed action timing across tempo settings.

title: [feat]/ Add optional synchronized DJ video playback and external output
problem: No video pipeline exists. Serato Video is an optional expansion and platform-specific interop such as Syphon must not be promised on Linux.
acceptance: Decode video beside audio with a measured synchronization budget
Provide crossfader-linked transitions and a separate audience output window/feed
Isolate video decode/render overload so audio remains stable
validation: Test mixed codecs and external display changes with recorded audio/video synchronization and audio deadline monitoring.

title: [feat]/ Mix approved streaming providers concurrently as a preview-comparison feature
problem: Serato 5.0 public beta advertises Open Streaming; stable 4.0 overview limits provider selection. Omatainer has no provider framework yet.
acceptance: Enable multiple authorized provider sessions without merging their identities or restrictions
Search provider catalogs with explicit source labels
Resolve concurrent deck loads and entitlement limits per provider without disrupting playback
validation: Requires approved live integrations for at least two providers and mixed outage/expiry tests; keep preview comparison labeled.

title: [feat]/ Populate prearranged clip placeholders from a live recording
problem: There is no way to plan repetitions and structure before a live source has been recorded.
acceptance: Place linked recording placeholders at chosen future arrangement positions.
Record an authorized source into a source slot and atomically resolve linked instances to the resulting take.
Preserve independent occurrence offsets/fades while keeping their source relationship visible.
Handle incomplete, cancelled or missing recordings without replacing placeholders with silent success.
validation: Prearrange a vocal loop through several song sections, record it during performance and verify every future occurrence plays correctly.

title: [feat]/ Support safe DJ handover on qualified dual-computer hardware
problem: Generic device recovery is not a booth handover workflow; current startup owns one default device with no per-channel ownership view.
acceptance: Show channel/deck ownership and hardware-supported USB source selection
Allow an inactive channel to be prepared and handed over without replacing the audible one
Document a verified manual fallback where automatic switching is unavailable
validation: Requires two computers and a dual-USB mixer/controller; record continuous master audio throughout changeover.

title: [feat]/ Implement arrangement split, consolidate and structural time editing
problem: Without timeline editing, producers cannot turn repeated ideas into complete structures or edit multitrack sections together.
acceptance: Implement split, trim, slip, duplicate, crop and consolidate with explicit destructive/non-destructive behavior.
Insert, duplicate, cut and delete time across selected tracks or the full arrangement.
Move attached automation with clips unless the user locks it to song time.
Preserve clip offsets and crossfade boundaries across variable-meter edits.
validation: Cut and duplicate a chorus spanning audio, MIDI and automation; undo, redo and reopen, then compare event positions and rendered transitions.

title: [feat]/ Record performance automation with explicit override and re-enable behavior
problem: GUI and controller changes currently replace values immediately without a recordable history.
acceptance: Record knob, fader and device gestures into Session or Arrangement automation as appropriate.
Separate recording arm from playback override so rehearsal does not silently rewrite automation.
Expose which parameters are overridden and provide per-parameter/global re-enable controls.
Thin redundant events within documented tolerances without changing audible gesture timing.
validation: Record a hardware-fader mix, override several lanes during playback and restore automation while verifying existing curves remain unchanged.

title: [feat]/ Implement take lanes and non-destructive audio/MIDI comping
problem: No take-lane model exists, so repeated performances cannot be auditioned and assembled without external editing.
acceptance: Retain each recording pass as a named take lane for audio and MIDI.
Audition takes and promote selected ranges into the main lane with visible provenance.
Edit comp boundaries and auto-crossfades without deleting alternative takes.
Support grouping takes across tracks and undoing a complete comp gesture.
validation: Record three vocal takes plus linked microphones, assemble a comp, revise a boundary and reopen with every original take intact.

title: [feat]/ Build nested instrument and effect racks with key, velocity and chain zones
problem: Every track currently has one fixed synth and a flat effect vector; layered or split instruments are unavailable.
acceptance: Create reusable nested serial/parallel instrument, MIDI-effect and audio-effect chains.
Define key, velocity and selector zones with adjustable crossfades.
Mix and mute/solo individual chains without losing their state or routing.
Flatten the processing graph safely and report per-chain latency and resource use.
validation: Build a velocity-layered piano/synth split with parallel processing, save as a preset and reproduce it on another track.

title: [feat]/ Deliver a musician-facing mixer with pan laws, stereo controls and solo semantics
problem: The current track controls expose gain/mute/solo only; pan exists internally but has no full mixer workflow.
acceptance: Provide linked Session/Arrangement mixer strips with faders, numeric gain, pan/balance and stereo-pan modes.
Expose input/output meters, clip indicators and clearly differentiated mute/solo/arm/monitor state.
Define solo-in-place, solo-safe and exclusive/additive selection behavior across groups and returns.
Offer keyboard-accessible multi-track adjustment without losing automation identity.
validation: Mix a multitrack song from both views and verify calibrated gains, pan positions, solo behavior and recorded automation.

title: [feat]/ Provide a fully editable stereo algorithmic reverb
problem: The tiny reverb implementation lacks a room/tail editor and independent stereo production controls.
acceptance: Expose early reflections, predelay, decay, size, diffusion and damping with sensible units.
Offer stereo width, filtering and freeze behavior without sharing channel state.
Report measurable tail length and maintain stable automation across sample-rate changes.
Expose named automatable controls and recall independent instance state from presets and projects.
validation: Measure impulse-decay curves for room and hall presets, inspect stereo correlation and compare saved-state renders.

title: [feat]/ Implement a playable record/overdub audio looper device
problem: Deck loops replay existing files; the app has no real-time pedal-style audio recording and overdubbing device.
acceptance: Provide record, play, overdub, stop, undo and clear actions with controller mapping.
Support sync-aware loop lengths, feedback, reverse and speed changes with clear state feedback.
Export/drag a completed loop into a normal audio clip while retaining original timing.
Expose named automatable controls and recall independent instance state from presets and projects.
validation: Build a three-layer guitar loop from live input, undo one overdub and transfer the result into Arrangement.

title: [feat]/ Provide tempo-synced auto-pan, tremolo and rhythmic chopping
problem: Spread and balance do not provide periodic movement or shaped amplitude modulation.
acceptance: Offer pan and amplitude modes with stereo phase, depth and offset controls.
Support free/synced rate, variable waveform shape and retrigger rules.
Provide smooth and intentionally stepped modes with click-safe transitions.
Expose named automatable controls and recall independent instance state from presets and projects.
validation: Render mono and stereo sources through a tempo change and confirm pan/amplitude cycles remain aligned.

title: [feat]/ Add tempo-synced beat repeat and controlled stutter processing
problem: Looping whole deck regions does not provide a track effect that captures and rearranges short rhythmic slices.
acceptance: Capture and repeat incoming audio at musical divisions with interval, offset and gate controls.
Allow controlled chance, pitch/decay variation and explicit insert/mix output modes.
Keep manual repeat grabs responsive and bounded without disrupting transport.
Expose named automatable controls and recall independent instance state from presets and projects.
validation: Perform manual and seeded repeats over a drum pattern, measuring capture boundaries and the return to dry playback.

title: [feat]/ Add an analog/digital character echo with modulation and noise shaping
problem: The single basic delay lacks a dedicated character-echo sound-design workflow.
acceptance: Provide stereo, ping-pong and mid/side echo routes with time modulation.
Expose diffusion, filtering, saturation, wow/flutter and optional noise controls using original algorithms.
Keep feedback stable and support ducking/gating plus a correctly compensated wet mix.
Expose named automatable controls and recall independent instance state from presets and projects.
validation: Create clean, tape-like and diffuse echo presets, measure timing and feedback decay and verify stereo independence.

title: [feat]/ Expand chorus into chorus, ensemble and vibrato processing
problem: The existing chorus branch is a minimal shared-delay effect without an ensemble or performance editor.
acceptance: Offer independently maintained stereo multi-tap chorus and dense ensemble modes.
Expose delay time, tap selection, rate, depth, width and tone with a true dry/wet path.
Include vibrato-only operation and safe feedback/modulation ranges.
Expose named automatable controls and recall independent instance state from presets and projects.
validation: Process bass, guitar and sustained synth fixtures, measure channel independence and verify recall of slow/fast modulation.

title: [feat]/ Implement convolution and hybrid reverb with licensed impulse responses
problem: There is no convolution engine or way to combine recorded spaces with synthetic reverb.
acceptance: Load user impulse responses with start/length, predelay, normalization and EQ controls.
Combine convolution and algorithmic stages in serial/parallel routings with correct latency compensation.
Distribute only original or appropriately licensed impulse responses and retain their provenance.
Expose named automatable controls and recall independent instance state from presets and projects.
validation: Load measured room IRs, compare convolution output with a reference and verify hybrid routing, latency and portable presets.

title: [feat]/ Add an integrated drum-bus processor with transient shaping and tuned low-end enhancement
problem: Producers need to shape a drum group cohesively in one recallable device. The current FX types provide a basic drive but no integrated drum compression, transient shaping or tuned low-frequency resonator.
acceptance: Provide an original integrated signal path with selectable drive character, compression and high-frequency/transient shaping controls suitable for drum groups.
Add a tunable low-end resonator with frequency, decay, amount and audition controls; bound its output under high drive and repeated excitation.
Expose input/output gain, dry/wet balance and level-matched bypass with smooth parameter automation and explicit latency reporting.
Save independent instance state and useful original kick, breakbeat and full-drum-bus presets without copying proprietary DSP or assets.
validation: Process isolated kicks and a multitrack drum group; measure resonant pitch and decay, confirm transient controls change attack predictably, automate all stages without discontinuities, and reopen the saved project with identical output.

title: [feat]/ Implement parallel filtered delay lines with independent pan and feedback
problem: No device offers multiple independently filtered rhythmic echoes.
acceptance: Provide several parallel delay lines with per-line input filter, timing, pan and feedback.
Allow synchronized and free time values plus independent gain/enable controls.
Keep parallel-line state isolated and expose coherent global mix behavior.
Expose named automatable controls and recall independent instance state from presets and projects.
validation: Create a three-part rhythmic echo and verify impulse arrival times, spectral filtering and pan of each line.

title: [feat]/ Add granular pitch-shifted delay for sound design
problem: The current FX list has no granular delay or controllable pitched feedback.
acceptance: Expose grain size, frequency/density, delay time, pitch and controlled random spread.
Provide separate dry/wet and feedback paths with safe gain behavior.
Offer tempo-related delay and deterministic render-seed options for reproducible sound design.
Expose named automatable controls and recall independent instance state from presets and projects.
validation: Create a pitched rhythmic texture from percussion, render repeatedly with a fixed seed and compare timing and level bounds.

title: [feat]/ Provide a metered mastering limiter with lookahead and stereo modes
problem: The master limiter is a fixed soft nonlinearity, not a configurable ceiling/true-peak mastering tool.
acceptance: Expose ceiling, lookahead, release, channel linking and input gain with gain-reduction metering.
Provide documented true-peak oversampling and latency reporting for supported quality modes.
Offer transparent and original character-limiting options with explicit loudness/ceiling tradeoffs.
Expose named automatable controls and recall independent instance state from presets and projects.
validation: Run intersample-peak and transient fixtures at multiple sample rates and verify measured exported peaks against the requested ceiling.

title: [feat]/ Provide bit reduction, erosion and vinyl-style texture processing
problem: No user-facing devices cover controlled digital degradation, noise modulation or record-like wear.
acceptance: Expose sample-rate/bit reduction with dithering/filter choices and controllable aliasing.
Provide sine/noise erosion with blend, bandwidth and stereo width.
Offer optional crackle, wear and mechanical-noise layers with predictable gain and bypass.
Expose named automatable controls and recall independent instance state from presets and projects.
validation: Process calibrated tones and a drum loop through each original algorithm, verifying spectral changes, silence behavior and stereo control.

title: [feat]/ Implement multiband compression, expansion and envelope shaping
problem: The current engine has no adjustable crossovers or independently processed dynamics bands.
acceptance: Provide phase-consistent adjustable crossovers with per-band solo and metering.
Support upward/downward compression and expansion with independent timing per band.
Include a multiband transient/envelope-shaping mode with bounded output and matched bypass.
Expose named automatable controls and recall independent instance state from presets and projects.
validation: Process a calibrated multitone/drum fixture, validate crossover recombination and independent band response.

title: [feat]/ Build a routable multistage saturation device with modulation
problem: There is no multi-stage or multiband distortion graph for complex animated sound design.
acceptance: Route independent distortion stages in serial, parallel and split-band configurations.
Expose stage curves, feedback, filters and a bounded modulation matrix.
Provide frequency-aware visualization and safe output control at extreme settings.
Expose named automatable controls and recall independent instance state from presets and projects.
validation: Design contrasting multi-stage patches and test feedback/automation stability at supported rates without reproducing proprietary presets.

title: [feat]/ Add a graphical parametric equalizer with stereo and mid/side editing
problem: Existing EQ3/5/8 split signals into fixed regions with few shared gain parameters; users cannot place arbitrary bands.
acceptance: Edit independent frequency, gain, Q, type and slope per active band in graph and numeric controls.
Offer stereo, left/right and mid/side processing with spectrum overlay and band audition.
Support quality options with documented latency and stable automation of filter coefficients.
Expose named automatable controls and recall independent instance state from presets and projects.
validation: Measure the response of saved multi-band curves at several sample rates and compare channel-isolated and mid/side renders.

title: [feat]/ Add phaser and flanger effects with controllable feedback and modulation
problem: No phaser/flanger device exists in the current effect enum.
acceptance: Provide selectable all-pass phasing and short-delay flanging algorithms with independent instance state.
Expose stages/range, rate, depth, feedback, stereo phase and mix.
Synchronize modulation to musical tempo and support safe manual-sweep operation.
Expose named automatable controls and recall independent instance state from presets and projects.
validation: Compare impulse/frequency sweeps and stereo motion for both modes, then automate a sweep across a tempo change.

title: [feat]/ Add real-time monophonic pitch correction and MIDI-driven harmony
problem: There is no vocal pitch-tracking/correction device or MIDI-controlled harmonization.
acceptance: Detect pitch and expose correction scale, tolerance, speed and expressive transition controls.
Provide formant-aware transposition and MIDI-driven harmony voices where supported.
Show detection confidence and let unvoiced material pass predictably.
Use original or licensed algorithms and document supported material and monitoring latency.
Expose named automatable controls and recall independent instance state from presets and projects.
validation: Record an authorized vocal phrase, audition correction and MIDI harmony, and measure pitch accuracy, artifacts and reported latency.

title: [feat]/ Add pitch shifting, frequency shifting and ring modulation
problem: Deck speed/keylock controls cannot replace track effects for pitch manipulation and inharmonic modulation.
acceptance: Provide pitch, frequency-shift and ring-modulation modes with appropriate units and controls.
Support modulation, feedback and independent stereo offsets with bounded output.
Expose algorithm quality/latency and preserve a genuine dry/wet mix.
Expose named automatable controls and recall independent instance state from presets and projects.
validation: Measure pitch/frequency movement of harmonic fixtures and compare latency-corrected dry/wet renders.

title: [feat]/ Provide tuned resonator banks and physically modeled resonant-body effects
problem: The FX enum lacks playable resonators and body modeling for resynthesis of incoming sound.
acceptance: Offer a bank of tuned resonators with damping, decay and scale-aware pitch relationships.
Provide distinct modeled-body modes with controllable excitation/position and optional MIDI pitch input.
Balance dry/body signals and keep high-resonance output stable.
Expose named automatable controls and recall independent instance state from presets and projects.
validation: Excite the devices with impulses and percussion, verify resonance frequencies/decays and play the effect from MIDI.

title: [feat]/ Provide waveshaping, tube and pedal-style saturation tools
problem: The current tanh drive exposes too little control for calibrated tonal and dynamic coloration.
acceptance: Offer distinct original waveshaping, tube-asymmetry and overdrive/distortion/fuzz modes.
Expose input/output gain, tonal shaping, bias and compensated dry/wet controls.
Provide oversampling quality choices and level-matched comparison without unreported latency.
Expose named automatable controls and recall independent instance state from presets and projects.
validation: Measure harmonic spectra and aliasing for each mode, then verify level-matched bypass and automated gain staging.

title: [feat]/ Add spectral resonation, spectral delay/freeze and spectral blur devices
problem: There is no spectral-domain processing despite these being distinct current Suite sound-design capabilities.
acceptance: Provide spectral resonation driven by tuned or MIDI targets with bounded harmonic control.
Offer spectral delay/freeze and frequency-dependent processing with clear latency.
Provide blur/freeze textures with selectable frequency range and separately mixed residual signal.
Expose named automatable controls and recall independent instance state from presets and projects.
validation: Freeze, retune and disperse a recorded chord, verify latency and state restoration and measure finite bounded output.

title: [feat]/ Build a configurable stereo delay with tempo divisions and advanced LFO shapes
problem: The existing delay slot cannot deliver a complete independently configured stereo creative-delay workflow.
acceptance: Expose independent/linked channel delay times in milliseconds or musical divisions with filtering and feedback.
Provide ping-pong, freeze, modulation shapes/morph and explicit time-change behavior.
Maintain smooth parameter transitions and independent state per slot, with latency/feedback safety.
Expose named automatable controls and recall independent instance state from presets and projects.
validation: Validate channel impulse timing at multiple BPMs and verify a modulated freeze/release gesture in a saved arrangement.

title: [feat]/ Follow the tempo of live incoming audio with controlled fallback
problem: detect_bpm analyzes completed samples; it cannot make the running set follow a drummer or other live timing source.
acceptance: Select an input and estimate tempo/phase continuously with confidence reporting.
Constrain tempo range, smoothing and response so ambiguous input does not create violent jumps.
Allow manual takeover, pause and stable fallback when the source becomes silent or irregular.
Keep warp, clip launch and metronome scheduling aligned to the followed tempo.
validation: Play against recorded and live drumming with accelerando, breaks and noise; measure tracking error and takeover behavior.

title: [feat]/ Provide gain/stereo/alignment utilities plus spectrum and tuning analysis
problem: Existing balance/spread controls are not a calibrated utility or diagnostic device suite.
acceptance: Expose gain, polarity, channel swap, mono, width, mid/side and low-frequency mono controls.
Offer a precise sample/time alignment delay independent of musical echo effects.
Provide configurable spectrum analysis and a tuner referenced to the project tuning system.
Expose named automatable controls and recall independent instance state from presets and projects.
validation: Run known channel, phase, impulse and frequency fixtures through the tools and verify indicated values against independent measurements.

title: [feat]/ Enable live deck stem separation without interrupting playback
problem: Current built-in drum/harmony samples are not source separation. Professional live remixing needs real audio stems with bounded processing cost.
acceptance: Reuse the shared separation service for vocal, drums, bass and musical-bed deck streams
Prioritize playback and show processing readiness before stem actions become active
Handle model failure or overload with a coherent full-mix fallback, never partial silence
validation: Run mixed-genre files on declared CPU/GPU hardware while recording callback deadlines and audible artifacts.

title: [feat]/ Prepare and manage cached stems before a performance
problem: There is no readiness queue or cache management for separation; a show cannot depend on last-second inference completing.
acceptance: Queue selected tracks/crates for background separation with progress and cancellation
Validate cached stems by source identity and model version
Show disk usage and remove only generated stem data when clearing the cache
validation: Prepare a crate, restart offline, alter a source file, and verify stale-cache detection plus uninterrupted playback.

title: [feat]/ Support explicitly qualified HID DJ media players
problem: Only midir MIDI input/output exists; CDJ-style HID deck assignment, browsing and displays are not implemented. Serato support is hardware-dependent.
acceptance: Implement a documented or legitimately licensed HID profile for at least one selected player
Offer deck assignment and library/transport controls without a control-tone path
Report unsupported firmware/devices clearly and avoid claims of universal CDJ support
validation: Requires the exact media-player hardware and firmware; verify reconnect, browsing and two-player operation.

title: [feat]/ Implement verified motorized platter control and calibration
problem: A controller name and jog binding do not provide motor drive, absolute rotation tracking or touch calibration for NS7/RANE-style performance.
acceptance: Define safe motor start/stop and touch/release behavior per supported model
Track high-resolution position with configurable platter speed and calibration
Stop motors safely on device loss and reject unsupported protocols
validation: Requires physical motorized hardware and measured rotation-to-audio response; simulator coverage alone is insufficient.

title: [feat]/ Provide CC controls, MIDI monitoring and expression-shaping devices
problem: The MIDI log is not a track device and there are no automatable CC controls or expression remapping tools.
acceptance: Expose named assignable CC controls with channel/range and automation support.
Display filtered per-track MIDI events, channels and high-resolution values without blocking audio.
Remap pressure, timbre, pitch and velocity curves with MPE-safe per-note ownership.
Avoid duplicate feedback when mapped controls both send and receive values.
validation: Control and monitor an external instrument, reshape an MPE trace and compare input/output event ownership and timing.

title: [feat]/ Build a programmable virtual-analog synth with mono, poly and expressive modes
problem: Three hardcoded oscillator mixtures are not an editable analog instrument; the current instrument labels also map inconsistently.
acceptance: Expose oscillators, noise, sync/sub options, resonant filters, envelopes, LFOs and a modulation matrix.
Support mono/legato/glide and polyphonic/unison playing with predictable voice stealing.
Provide drift/expression controls and original bass, lead and poly presets without cloning commercial patches.
Expose named automatable controls and recall independent instance state from presets and projects.
validation: Program a bass, lead and poly pad from initialized state, automate modulation and compare deterministic preset recall.

title: [feat]/ Grab and release arrangement loops during live performance
problem: The app has deck loops but no performer-facing way to extend the current arrangement section on demand.
acceptance: Capture a loop around the current arrangement position with configurable musical lengths.
Change loop length or release to continuation at a quantized boundary.
Show original timeline position and prevent surprises when tempo/meter changes occur inside the loop.
Allow MIDI/keyboard mapping without switching away from the live performance page.
validation: Extend a breakdown repeatedly, resize its loop and release into the next section while verifying note and automation continuity.

title: [feat]/ Provide linked and independent clip modulation envelopes
problem: Clips lack automation/modulation content, so cyclic movement cannot travel with a musical idea.
acceptance: Attach parameter modulation and applicable audio/MIDI envelopes to clips.
Support envelope loops whose lengths and start offsets differ from the note/audio loop.
Distinguish relative modulation from absolute automation and show their combined result.
Copy, stretch and consolidate clips while preserving envelope phase and intended target mappings.
validation: Create a three-bar filter envelope on a four-bar loop, record the performance and verify the twelve-bar combined cycle.

title: [feat]/ Create a per-hit drum sampler with transient shaping and creative playback
problem: Current pad banks cannot be user-authored or shaped per hit; producers need drum-focused editing independent of the deck.
acceptance: Edit sample boundaries, fades, tuning, pitch envelope and velocity response on a clear waveform.
Provide one-shot/gate modes and independently configurable per-hit playback effects.
Support sample replacement and rack integration without changing the receiving pad note.
Expose named automatable controls and recall independent instance state from presets and projects.
validation: Load kick, snare and hats, shape their transients and replace one source while validating timing and rack mappings.

title: [feat]/ Provide a modeled electric-piano instrument
problem: The keys choice selects a generic synth voice rather than a playable tine/reed/pickup model.
acceptance: Model controllable hammer, tine/reed, damper and pickup behavior with responsive velocity.
Support sustain/release interactions, tuning and noise controls appropriate to keyboard performance.
Include original clean and driven presets with consistent gain across velocity layers.
Expose named automatable controls and recall independent instance state from presets and projects.
validation: Perform soft-to-hard passages with sustain pedal, verify release behavior and compare preset renders at identical MIDI input.

title: [feat]/ Host user-authored audio, MIDI and instrument devices through an open extension runtime
problem: Max for Live is included in Suite, while Omatainer only compiles a fixed Rust device enum; users cannot add their own creative devices.
acceptance: Define a documented versioned extension contract for audio/MIDI/instrument processing, parameters and persistent state.
Run third-party code with explicit realtime, memory and capability boundaries and recover from device failure.
Integrate device automation, controller display and asset dependency resolution with ordinary chains.
Choose an original open runtime or separately licensed integration; do not promise loading proprietary Max patches or shipping Max without authorization.
validation: Build an example MIDI transformer and audio device outside the app, install them, automate them and recover from a deliberately failing extension.

title: [feat]/ Add an FM and additive synthesis instrument
problem: The fixed subtractive voices cannot produce editable operator-based frequency modulation or harmonic spectra.
acceptance: Provide multiple operators with frequency ratios/fixed frequency, envelopes and selectable routings.
Allow user-shaped harmonic spectra and feedback with bounded stable behavior.
Integrate filters, modulation and expressive per-note controls across polyphonic voices.
Expose named automatable controls and recall independent instance state from presets and projects.
validation: Create bell, electric-key and bass patches from operators, then verify tuning, modulation and safe peak levels across the keyboard.

title: [feat]/ Freeze and unfreeze tracks without sacrificing editability
problem: All tracks render live continuously; there is no way to trade CPU for a recoverable rendered track.
acceptance: Create a background rendered cache of track clips/instruments/effects with source state retained.
Play frozen material with consistent timing, tails and routing while disabling redundant processing.
Invalidate or explicitly protect the cache when relevant edits change the sound.
Unfreeze losslessly and diagnose missing devices without deleting their retained state.
validation: Freeze a resource-heavy instrument track, measure the actual processing reduction and confirm an unfreeze restores identical editable content.

title: [feat]/ Provide a sample-based granular synthesis instrument
problem: Deck keylock uses grains internally, but there is no playable granular sound-design instrument.
acceptance: Load user audio and expose grain position, size, density, shape, pitch and scan behavior.
Offer contrasting scan/hold playback modes and live sample capture with explicit buffer ownership.
Map per-note expression to grain controls while keeping realtime processing bounded.
Expose named automatable controls and recall independent instance state from presets and projects.
validation: Transform an authorized field recording into an expressive pad, capture new material live and reopen its self-contained preset.

title: [feat]/ Create an expressive dual-layer macro-oscillator instrument
problem: The existing voices cannot combine independently modulated sound engines for complex evolving textures.
acceptance: Offer two independently configurable macro-oscillator layers with complementary synthesis models.
Route modulation within and between layers using visible, bounded assignments.
Support per-note expression and tuning-aware oscillator/filter relationships.
Expose named automatable controls and recall independent instance state from presets and projects.
validation: Design an evolving dual-layer texture, record MPE gestures and verify layer isolation, modulation and project recall.

title: [feat]/ Add physical-model mallet and resonant-percussion instruments
problem: Fixed synthesized drums do not provide editable struck-resonator instruments for tuned percussion.
acceptance: Combine mallet/noise excitation with selectable resonator materials and geometries.
Expose damping, brightness, position and pitch controls with velocity-sensitive response.
Keep extreme resonator settings stable and support expressive polyphony and microtuning.
Expose named automatable controls and recall independent instance state from presets and projects.
validation: Create wood, metal and glass-like mallet patches, verify pitch/decay behavior and stress maximum resonance.

title: [feat]/ Build an editable chromatic single-sample instrument
problem: Pad voices replay fixed sample banks; producers need playable user samples with visible sound-shaping controls.
acceptance: Load user samples with waveform start/end, loop, reverse and root-pitch editing.
Offer chromatic classic, one-shot and slicing playback with envelopes and resonant filtering.
Integrate warp and velocity/expression routing while sharing sample data between voices.
Expose named automatable controls and recall independent instance state from presets and projects.
validation: Create a playable vocal instrument from an authorized recording, edit its loop and render sustained polyphony without loop clicks.

title: [feat]/ Add a physical-model string synthesis instrument
problem: The pad oscillator cannot model plucked, bowed or hammered strings and resonant bodies.
acceptance: Provide independent excitation, string, damper and body controls.
Support continuous and transient excitation with pitch tracking and expressive playing.
Bound resonances and preserve stable voice termination with sustain and retriggering.
Expose named automatable controls and recall independent instance state from presets and projects.
validation: Create plucked and bowed patches, play chords with expression and verify decay stability and tuning across registers.

title: [feat]/ Add a morphing wavetable instrument with user-table import
problem: There is no wavetable data model, scan control or modulation matrix in the synth engine.
acceptance: Provide independently tuned wavetable oscillators with scanning, sub oscillator and filters.
Import documented user wavetable formats with validation and spectral anti-aliasing strategy.
Support expressive modulation, unison and configurable polyphony with measured CPU limits.
Expose named automatable controls and recall independent instance state from presets and projects.
validation: Import an original wavetable, build a scanning pad and render high-note sweeps to evaluate aliasing and preset portability.

title: [feat]/ Browse, tag and audition instruments, presets, clips and production samples
problem: The crate only scans filenames under Music and loads tracks to decks; it is not a production-content browser.
acceptance: Index devices, presets, clips and sample locations with editable tags and saved filters.
Audition samples in tempo and hot-swap sounds while retaining the target track/rack context.
Provide browsing history, favorites and missing-content state without blocking the UI.
Keep factory content read-only while allowing user tags and presets with accessible keyboard navigation.
validation: Find and audition content in a large library, replace one drum-pad sound and save a tagged user preset without changing other pads.

title: [feat]/ Support linked multitrack editing for phase-coherent recordings
problem: Eight independent track cells provide no way to preserve alignment while editing multi-microphone recordings.
acceptance: Create explicit linked-edit groups independent of mix groups.
Apply matching trim, split, warp and comp selections across linked tracks.
Display link membership and let users temporarily suspend linked editing.
Reject or clearly resolve incompatible region boundaries rather than drifting tracks silently.
validation: Edit a multi-mic drum recording and verify sample-relative offsets remain unchanged across comp, warp and split operations.

title: [feat]/ Provide a user-editable drum rack with per-pad chains and choke groups
problem: The sampler has fixed banks and global instrument selection; users cannot build kits from their own devices and samples.
acceptance: Assign samples or instruments to named MIDI pads with independent gain, pan and effects.
Support choke groups, receive/play-note mapping and per-pad multi-output routing.
Expose a pad mixer, audition and swap/duplicate/extract-pad operations.
Persist kit presets with original or legally redistributable referenced content.
validation: Build a kit with closed/open-hat choking and separate kick/snare outputs, sequence it and verify mute/solo/routing from the pad mixer.

title: [feat]/ Implement nested group tracks, subgroup mixing and track organization
problem: Tracks are a flat fixed array with no parent groups or shared musician-facing bus controls.
acceptance: Create and nest group tracks with clear child routing and independent subgroup device chains.
Fold/unfold groups and launch or stop their contained Session material coherently.
Apply group mute/solo/gain while preserving individual child settings and metering.
Move, duplicate and ungroup tracks without losing sends, automation or clip references.
validation: Organize a 64-track production into nested drum/music/vocal groups and verify bus renders, solo behavior and duplication.

title: [feat]/ Add auxiliary sends, returns and musician-facing sidechain routing
problem: The engine has fixed master effects, but no per-track sends or routable detector/control inputs.
acceptance: Create named returns with configurable pre/post-fader sends and metered send levels.
Expose sidechain source and tap point per compatible device, including multi-output instruments.
Validate routing cycles and require explicit safe feedback configuration.
Preserve sends/sidechains on track/group duplication and show missing routes clearly.
validation: Mix a shared reverb return, pre-fader cue effect and kick-ducked bass, then verify renders and route restoration after reopen.

title: [feat]/ Record Session performances into Arrangement and restore arrangement control
problem: Current clip launches only set transient PlayingClip state; live improvisations cannot become editable songs.
acceptance: Record clip launches, stops and performance automation into arrangement clip instances.
Show tracks temporarily overridden by Session playback and support per-track/global return to arrangement.
Preserve source offsets when recording legato launches and loop repetitions.
Allow a recorded performance to continue independently after the original Session grid changes.
validation: Perform a two-minute Session jam, return to Arrangement and reproduce its launches and fader moves without the controller.

title: [feat]/ Add guitar/bass amplifier and cabinet simulation
problem: The app cannot process a direct guitar into a controllable amplifier-and-speaker sound without external software.
acceptance: Provide original or licensed clean/crunch/high-gain guitar and bass amplifier models.
Offer cabinet/microphone choices or user IR loading with placement/width controls.
Separate amp/cab stages and integrate realtime monitoring and latency reporting.
Expose named automatable controls and recall independent instance state from presets and projects.
validation: Record a DI guitar through clean and driven rigs, verify monitor latency and reproduce the printed sound after reopen.

title: [feat]/ Apply performance FX and rolls to selected stems
problem: The current effects paths process tracks or the scene mix, not isolated components of a deck.
acceptance: Assign FX/roll actions to one or more stems with visible routing
Offer tempo-related parameters and momentary/latching behavior
Preserve timing and the unaffected stems when routing changes
validation: Record per-stem reference outputs through rapid FX selection and roll release.

title: [feat]/ Add per-stem mute, solo and level controls on decks
problem: There are no deck stem controls or controller pad state for live acapella/instrumental mixing.
acceptance: Provide individual mute/solo/level and quick vocal/instrumental selection
Keep stem state visible in pad colors and waveform presentation
Persist a documented per-load reset policy and support MIDI mappings
validation: Audition all stem combinations with prepared and still-processing tracks through UI and hardware.

title: [feat]/ Publish library and deck information to supported controller screens
problem: Omatainer has no hardware display protocol or artwork/waveform transport. This is model-specific functionality, not generic MIDI support.
acceptance: Provide selected track, playing title, time and deck assignment on a qualified device
Send cue/grid/waveform/artwork data only where the protocol supports it
Bound bandwidth and refresh stale display content after load/reconnect
validation: Inspect exact supported hardware while rapidly browsing and loading; measure that feedback does not delay input.

title: [feat]/ Provide composable pitch, scale, chord, random, velocity and note-length MIDI effects
problem: The only MIDI effect is a special-case track arp; there is no configurable MIDI processing chain.
acceptance: Implement independently insertable pitch/scale mapping, chord generation, randomization, velocity and note-length devices.
Keep note-on/off and expression ownership valid through transforms, splits and held-note parameter changes.
Provide scale awareness, ranges and reproducible random seeds with user-visible musical units.
Support serial and parallel MIDI-effect racks before instruments and hardware outputs.
validation: Build a transformed chord/arpeggio chain, change parameters while holding notes and verify valid output events with no orphaned notes.

title: [feat]/ Add a multisample instrument with key/velocity zones and modulation
problem: The engine has no user-imported multisample key/velocity zone map despite its six-sample drum kit and three generated 16-pad banks.
acceptance: Create and edit overlapping key/velocity zones with root pitch, crossfades and release samples.
Support sustain/release loops, per-zone gain/tuning and modulation of synthesis parameters.
Load documented open sample-instrument formats only where supported and preserve source licensing metadata.
Expose named automatable controls and recall independent instance state from presets and projects.
validation: Build a velocity-layered acoustic instrument with release noises, save it and verify zone boundaries and sustain behavior.

title: [feat]/ Map rack macros and recall named macro variations
problem: There is no multi-parameter mapping or device-level variation system for sound design and live use.
acceptance: Map multiple compatible parameters to named macros with ranges, polarity and curves.
Provide learn, reorder and controller-friendly macro banks with meaningful units.
Store and recall named macro snapshots with selective exclusions and randomization bounds.
Retain mappings across nested-rack edits and expose modulated versus base values.
validation: Build a performance rack controlling ten targets, save four variations and recall them without breaking parameter ownership.

title: [feat]/ Add sequenced, pitch-reversing and dual-buffer creative delay devices
problem: Core delay cannot provide the distinct gated, pitch-feedback and micro-loop workflows found in Suite-included creative extensions.
acceptance: Gate sends to delay using editable musical step sequences.
Provide pitch/reverse feedback transformations with bounded gain and controllable randomness.
Offer independently controlled short-loop buffers for freeze, jitter and pitch motion.
Implement original algorithms and presets rather than distributing proprietary Max patches.
validation: Build gated, reverse-pitched and micro-loop textures from authorized audio; validate seed recall, tails and stability.

title: [feat]/ Provide visual/code device authoring, a musical object API and custom MIDI tools
problem: A runtime alone does not replace the authoring and project-control capabilities producers use from Max for Live.
acceptance: Provide a supported authoring workflow with signal/MIDI/control building blocks and inspectable realtime errors.
Expose safe stable-identity APIs for clips, notes, parameters and transport with observer lifetimes and capability checks.
Allow custom MIDI transformations/generators to preview and commit edits through the same undoable tool interface.
Package dependencies and examples with original code and explicit licenses; exclude beta-only Ableton Extensions SDK compatibility claims.
validation: Author a custom MIDI generator and parameter-observer device from documentation, package them and load the result on a clean installation.

title: [feat]/ Bounce clips, selected ranges and groups into editable audio tracks
problem: There is no in-project bounce workflow for sound design, printing external gear or committing groups.
acceptance: Bounce selected clips/time ranges or whole groups with explicit pre/post-effects and tail boundaries.
Create new aligned audio tracks or replace material only through an explicit reversible choice.
Respect sidechains, tempo automation and source offsets when rendering a selection.
Support realtime bounce for external hardware and retain provenance of the source state.
validation: Bounce a sidechained group and a hardware-instrument passage, then compare timing and audible output with their source playback.

title: [feat]/ Extend dynamics processing into configurable compressor and bus-compressor devices
problem: The existing small compressor branch lacks the controls, detector routing and gain-reduction workflow needed for mixing.
acceptance: Expose threshold, ratio, knee, attack, release, makeup and dry/wet with meaningful units.
Offer peak/RMS detection, stereo-link behavior and an external filtered sidechain.
Provide a separate original bus-compressor character mode with level-matched comparison and gain-reduction metering.
Expose named automatable controls and recall independent instance state from presets and projects.
validation: Measure transfer curves and attack/release response on calibrated fixtures, then duck bass from a kick sidechain in a saved session.

title: [feat]/ Add a fully controllable gate and expander with sidechain audition
problem: A threshold-only gate is insufficient for transparent cleanup and rhythmic noise shaping.
acceptance: Expose threshold, hysteresis, attack, hold, release and reduction-range controls.
Provide filtered external sidechain input and detector audition.
Support smooth gating/expansion without clicks or unintended channel imbalance.
Expose named automatable controls and recall independent instance state from presets and projects.
validation: Clean a noisy vocal and shape a drum room using sidechain input, measuring transitions and recall.

title: [feat]/ Add a modulation-capable filter device with envelope follower and sidechain
problem: The basic filter branch cannot expose the production modulation and detector workflow used in creative filtering.
acceptance: Provide multiple filter responses, slope/drive choices and smooth automatable cutoff/resonance.
Include tempo/free-rate LFO shapes with phase/morph and envelope-follow controls.
Allow external detector input and show modulation separately from base cutoff.
Expose named automatable controls and recall independent instance state from presets and projects.
validation: Create a tempo-synced moving filter and an audio-followed bass effect, verifying detector routing and automation continuity.

title: [feat]/ Add a playable vocoder with external carrier routing
problem: No analysis/synthesis filter bank can impose vocal articulation on an instrument or noise carrier.
acceptance: Provide internal noise/oscillator and external carrier choices with explicit routing.
Expose analysis bands, formant shift, attack/release and voiced/unvoiced handling.
Support stereo output and MIDI-controlled carriers without channel-state leakage.
Expose named automatable controls and recall independent instance state from presets and projects.
validation: Route a voice and synth carrier through the vocoder, vary articulation and compare independent left/right behavior.

title: [feat]/ Split stems across linked deck mixer channels
problem: Independent vocal and instrumental mixing needs linked transports with separate channel processing; no linked-deck state exists. Hardware-dependent Serato Stem Split is the benchmark.
acceptance: Duplicate an analyzed track into linked vocal/instrumental deck roles
Share transport timing while allowing independent gain and FX
Provide a safe unlink/restore action without losing original full-track state
validation: Measure phase coherence through sync, cue and loop actions across four-deck routing.

title: [feat]/ Provide evolving step, probability and polyrhythmic sequencer devices
problem: Only a fixed clip-note list exists; Suite-bundled sequencers and MIDI Tools establish a broader generative workflow benchmark.
acceptance: Offer independently sized lanes for pitch, rhythm, velocity, gate and probability with visible playheads.
Provide deterministic stage/rule-based sequencing and controlled randomization with reset/seed controls.
Route generated MIDI to instruments or record it into ordinary editable clips.
Supply original example patches covering melodic, probabilistic and Euclidean/polymetric use without copying Pack assets.
validation: Perform and capture an evolving polymetric sequence, reproduce it from a seed and edit the recorded result without the generator.

title: [feat]/ Add performance arpeggiator and MIDI note-echo devices
problem: The existing arp only steps notes already in a clip; live input needs editable rhythmic processing and note echoes.
acceptance: Offer hold/latch, direction, rhythmic rate, octave range, gate and retrigger controls for live arpeggiation.
Generate note echoes with tempo delay, repeats, velocity decay and optional pitch changes.
Coordinate generated note ownership with sustain, input releases and transport/tempo changes.
Expose deterministic patterns and permit recording the processed MIDI output into clips.
validation: Feed live chords through an arp and note echo, capture their output and verify timing and note closure across stop/restart.

title: [feat]/ Provide full production control for Push 1 and Push 2
problem: Factory maps cover APC/MPK and DJ controllers but contain no Push production workflow or screen integration.
acceptance: Support note/drum layouts, step sequencing, clip/scene control, track selection and transport with bidirectional feedback.
Expose device/macro browsing, parameter banks, mixer controls and relevant screen content.
Support fixed-length recording, quantization and sample editing from the controller.
Use documented or legally usable protocols and state tested model/firmware compatibility explicitly.
validation: Create a complete drum-and-bass Session sketch using actual Push1 and Push2 hardware, then verify displayed values against project state.

title: [feat]/ Ship an original tagged production library of kits, presets, loops and clips
problem: The factory content is one house demo and generated banks; producers need diverse legal starting points rather than copied Ableton content.
acceptance: Create a curated original or licensed core collection spanning drum kits, synth presets, audio/MIDI loops and useful device racks.
Tag tempo, key, instrumentation, articulation and style consistently for browsing and similarity search.
Include simple, mix-ready and experimental examples that exercise the supported devices with sensible levels.
Record authorship, redistribution rights and attribution per asset; provide optional downloads with integrity/version metadata.
validation: Install the content on a clean offline machine, audition representative material and verify every referenced asset and license manifest.

title: [feat]/ Provide editable kick, snare, clap, hat, cymbal, tom and metallic drum synthesis
problem: synth_drum creates canned buffers but there is no editable drum-synthesis instrument family.
acceptance: Offer distinct percussion models with appropriate pitch/noise/resonance and amplitude envelopes.
Map velocity/expression to meaningful timbre and dynamics without uncontrolled peaks.
Provide tuned tom/FM/metallic variants and parameter ranges suited to original kit design.
Expose named automatable controls and recall independent instance state from presets and projects.
validation: Design and sequence a complete synthesized kit, vary velocity and render repeatable isolated hits for every model.

title: [feat]/ Add assignable LFO, envelope, shaper and performance-expression modulators
problem: Parameter changes are absolute immediate commands; producers cannot layer reusable modulation over editable base values.
acceptance: Provide tempo/free LFO, audio-envelope follower, note-triggered envelope and drawable repeating shaper sources.
Map each source to several parameter targets with ranges, polarity, smoothing and base-value preservation.
Map velocity, key tracking, pitch bend, mod wheel and pressure as expressive sources.
Visualize combined modulation and stop/remove sources without leaving targets at stale offsets.
validation: Modulate a filter and rack macro from several sources, adjust their base values live and verify deterministic rendering and removal.

title: [feat]/ Slice samples to playable pads and reconstruct their rhythm as MIDI
problem: Pad banks are synthesized constants; users cannot slice their own breaks or route slices to a drum instrument.
acceptance: Slice user audio by transient, warp marker or fixed musical division.
Create a drum/sampler instrument with independently editable slice boundaries and envelopes.
Generate a MIDI reconstruction preserving original order and timing.
Keep sample references shared and allow reslicing without silently corrupting the original clip.
validation: Slice a break, reproduce the original loop from generated MIDI and then rearrange the slices into a new pattern.

title: [feat]/ Create customizable performance macro pages spanning the whole set
problem: Rack macros alone cannot present a tailored live-control surface across tracks and external gear; Suite Performance Pack is the benchmark.
acceptance: Create named pages of faders, buttons, dials and crossfaders mapped to multiple project targets.
Edit mapping curves/ranges and preserve controller feedback without overriding target ownership.
Support page templates reflecting actual controllers and accessible on-screen operation.
Protect critical transport/record actions with explicit mapping state and visible targets.
validation: Build a controller-specific performance page, switch banks during a set and verify target feedback and state after reopen.

title: [feat]/ Add stem-specific slip performance gestures
problem: Serato 4.0.10/T10 introduces stem slip interactions; Omatainer has neither isolated stem playheads nor slip state. Treat hardware behavior as model-specific.
acceptance: Allow a chosen stem to enter a temporary slip gesture while other stems continue
Rejoin coherently at the shadow playhead with explicit release timing
Expose supported gestures and state on screen and in controller profiles
validation: Perform cue/scratch/release routines against multitrack references and test each advertised controller separately.

title: [feat]/ Find and swap acoustically similar production samples
problem: The browser only compares filename text; producers cannot explore alternatives by sound characteristics.
acceptance: Analyze supported local samples asynchronously into a versioned acoustic index.
Find similar timbre/envelope candidates from user-selected sounds with explainable filters.
