Preview and swap rack samples individually or as a kit while retaining mappings and user edits.
Make analysis opt-in, cancellable and local unless a separate provider is explicitly selected.
validation: Index a licensed drum corpus, evaluate similarity retrieval against tagged fixtures and replace a kit without interrupting playback.

title: [feat]/ Insert external hardware effects with round-trip latency calibration
problem: No track device can route a send/return pair through outboard processing and keep it aligned.
acceptance: Choose explicit hardware send/return channels and show gain, meter and connection state.
Measure or enter round-trip latency and integrate it with compensation.
Provide safe bypass and feedback-loop warnings for mispatched outputs.
Mark sessions requiring realtime rendering and support calibrated realtime bounce.
validation: Loop through an outboard compressor or physical loopback and verify alignment, bypass level and realtime export behavior.

title: [feat]/ Integrate external MIDI instruments as latency-compensated track devices
problem: MIDI output helpers are not an external-instrument workflow with coupled audio return and rendering.
acceptance: Bind a device to an explicit MIDI destination/channel plus audio-return channels.
Provide calibrated hardware latency, gain and patch selection with visible connection status.
Support realtime freeze/bounce and retain timing alignment with software instruments.
Recover from port changes without silently sending notes to a different instrument.
validation: Sequence an external synth beside a software reference, calibrate return timing and print aligned audio through realtime bounce.

title: [feat]/ Support expressive Push 3 controller workflows without implying standalone licensing
problem: Push3 adds expressive hardware interaction; the repository has no model-specific support and no licensed route to installing an app into its standalone OS.
acceptance: Support controller-mode polyphonic pitch, pressure and slide with configurable pad sensitivity and note layouts.
Provide navigation, browser/device/mixer feedback and expressive step editing where the protocol permits.
Test audio/MIDI interface behavior and clearly distinguish controller compatibility from unsupported standalone execution.
Document the licensing/protocol boundary and do not redistribute Ableton firmware or claim standalone compatibility without authorization.
validation: Record and edit an expressive performance on physical Push3 in controller mode, comparing gesture playback and screen feedback.

title: [feat]/ Recall selective performance snapshots across tracks and devices
problem: The app stores only immediate runtime values; performers cannot recall coherent scenes of mixer/device state.
acceptance: Capture named snapshots of explicitly selected tracks, devices, routing and macro values.
Exclude protected parameters and show differences before overwriting stored snapshots.
Recall from clips/scenes/controllers at a musical boundary with optional safe interpolation.
Preserve sounding-note ownership and reject invalid references after project edits.
validation: Store and recall several complete performance states during playback, verifying exclusions, transitions and saved-session restoration.

title: [feat]/ Integrate pitch, gates, clocks and modulation with modular hardware
problem: There is no CV calibration or modular-signal workflow; ordinary audio outputs cannot safely imply control-voltage support.
acceptance: Expose calibrated pitch/gate/trigger/clock output and matching clock/control input where hardware supports it.
Provide voltage/range and DC-coupled-device requirements explicitly, with safe defaults and per-output limits.
Map incoming CV/audio envelopes to parameters and generate LFO/shaper/utility control signals.
Store hardware calibration profiles and provide a test mode that requires deliberate routing.
validation: Use a documented compatible interface and modular test setup to measure tuning, voltage range, trigger timing and disconnect behavior.

title: [feat]/ Add optional licensed acoustic drums, pianos, electric keys, guitar and bass libraries
problem: Current synthesized samples do not cover nuanced acoustic instruments represented by Suite-bundled sound packs.
acceptance: Provide independently recorded or licensed multisampled drums, piano, electric keyboard, guitar and bass content.
Support meaningful velocity layers, round-robin/release behavior and relevant articulations in the sampler/racks.
Offer both dry and room/character variants with original performance clips and consistent loudness.
Keep downloads optional and publish source/performer rights and redistribution licenses without copying commercial Pack samples.
validation: Play dynamic passages for each instrument family, audit zone/articulation transitions and verify portable project packaging.

title: [feat]/ Add original vocal, foley, cinematic, electronic and generative production packs
problem: The single demo lacks the vocal, found-sound, cinematic and electronic building blocks in current Suite content families.
acceptance: Provide original or licensed vocal material, foley, textures, drones, electronic drums and genre-spanning synth/rack presets.
Include playable instruments and editable clips, not only flattened demonstration audio.
Supply construction examples showing sampling, MPE and modulation with clear tempo/key/tuning metadata.
Document performer consent and usage terms; keep optional content clearly distinct from core application capabilities.
validation: Build contrasting vocal/electronic/cinematic sketches solely from installed content and verify editable sources and redistribution documentation.

title: [feat]/ Add optional orchestral, chamber and global-percussion instrument collections
problem: There are no orchestral or culturally varied acoustic instruments; Suite content establishes a breadth benchmark rather than an asset-copying permission.
acceptance: Provide original or licensed strings, brass, woodwinds, mallets and chamber ensembles with usable articulation switching.
Include documented global-percussion instruments with appropriate performance mappings and creator attribution.
Keep sample provenance, tuning and articulation metadata visible and consistent with the instrument UI.
Make these optional downloads and avoid claiming the recordings or branding of existing commercial Packs.
validation: Create a short ensemble arrangement with dynamic/articulation changes and verify every instrument mapping and license manifest.

title: [feat]/ Provide playable physics-inspired modulation and generative sound devices
problem: The project has no generative particle/physical-process control sources; Suite-included Inspired by Nature represents this distinct creative category.
acceptance: Provide original gravity/orbit/collision or growth-inspired generators with visible deterministic state.
Map generated events to MIDI, modulation and applicable sample/granular parameters.
Expose seed, reset, rate and bounded-complexity controls so projects replay safely.
Ship original examples and explain that benchmark Pack assets/patches are not redistributed.
validation: Create a deterministic evolving composition using two independent generators, render repeatedly and confirm repeatability and bounded processing.

title: [feat]/ Integrate optional licensed sample-provider search and audition for production
problem: Live12.3 includes Splice integration, but external catalogs and subscriptions are not free factory assets; Omatainer has no provider abstraction.
acceptance: Provide a provider-neutral search, preview, license/acquire and import workflow with explicit account/cost state.
Support similarity or audio-query search only where a provider officially exposes and permits it.
Download acquired assets into managed project media with receipts/provenance and offline fallback.
Keep the provider optional and use authorized APIs; do not scrape protected catalogs or imply subscription content is bundled.
validation: Using an authorized test account, preview and license a sample, import it into a project and verify offline reopening and entitlement errors.
